title: Defy the Heavens — Cliff Spire Cover Variations

prompts.name: 01-golden-defiance
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / reference-based cinematic cover variation.
Reference image is the supplied "Against Infinity" cover. Create ONE new landscape 16:9 cover, preserving its specific shot angle and visual identity: wide, cinematic, side / three-quarter view from across the abyss of a lone cultivator climbing the LEFT face of a sharply pointed central rock spire. His face is seen in upward-looking profile / three-quarter profile, he ascends diagonally toward upper right, one hand reaching above, the other clinging to rock, knees braced. Keep the camera outside the cliff looking across at the man, keep his full climbing body legible, keep the spire rising from bottom center toward upper-middle right, and keep the immense receding chasm on BOTH sides. Do not replace with a front-on portrait, selfie-like foreground hand, overhead shot, or close-up. Preserve the mood and geography of the reference without exact pixel duplication.
Requested improvement: this is a COVER, the centered cultivator must POP and be immediately identifiable at thumbnail scale. Increase his apparent size about 25-35 percent relative to the reference, with his visible body spanning roughly half the frame height; retain epic panorama. Illuminate his face, hands, shoulders and torn silk with motivated soft heavenly key light and a distinct narrow rim light. Give a thin region of pale mist behind his dark silhouette, darken and simplify competing distant detail slightly, strongest fine detail and local contrast on him. Richer selective color in the robe and face without garish saturation. Render an adult Chinese male cultivator with black windblown hair, dark worn silk robes, a readable expression of exhausted determination, anguish and unbreakable grit. Exactly two arms, two legs, coherent climbing anatomy.
Countless spectral hands of despair surge from the abyss below, gripping ankles, robe, waist and rock, pulling downward as he claws upward toward heaven. The hands remain separate spectral entities, subtle smoky forms receding into depth. Preserve the reference's radiant heavenly xianxia mountains and temples high above, towering blue-black cliffs, deep mist, immense scale, no moon. No modern objects, no extra main figure, no weapons, no gore.
World art style: smooth painterly illustrated xianxia, clean contours, refined brushwork, elegant anatomy, rich fabric detail, deep colour, controlled luminous spiritual light; beauty with dark cosmic horror. Premium narrative illustration, not glossy plastic CGI.
Typography: the exact title "DEFY THE HEAVENS" prominently across the upper negative space, elegant monumental weathered gold serif typography, balanced and readable, comfortably inset from all edges. It can occupy two lines as in reference. Keep lettering completely clear of the climber's head and raised hand. No subtitle, no additional text, no borders or watermark.
Variation: the closest faithful refinement of the reference. Warm gold heavenly key light falls directly on the cultivator's face and reaching arm; clear gold rim traces hair and left robe edge. Rich charcoal silk with faded burgundy lining. A pale mist pocket behind his shoulders emphasizes silhouette. Preserve slate-blue chasm, gold heaven, restrained palette and balanced original composition.
